acceptanceCriteria: Decide by verifier contract change (with Python-oracle/divergence adjudication) whether a Go t.Run case anchor on its parent func header line is admitted; record the decision and either implement it in extractableGoClaim (internal/lrfrepo/ocm.go) or keep OCM-V0-018's unsupported boundary.

Align or document the parent-test derivation in internal/lrfrepo/ocm_goindex.go (anchor position) versus extractableGoClaim (last Test header ending before the anchor line), with a test pinning the agreed rule.
body: Found by the V1-0520 lane (2026-10-08, base f33ea8ef, lane head 67a0a8e2). An inline layout such as `func TestX(t *testing.T) { t.Run("case", ...) }` yields only the test claim: candidate listing (ocm_goindex.go:135) derives the parent from the anchor position, while the verifier (ocm.go:874 extractableGoClaim) takes the last Test header that ends before the anchor's line starts, so a same-line anchor has no parent and the candidate is dropped (claim-selector-out-of-range). V1-0520 kept this as the proposed OCM-V0-018 boundary and fixed the misleading hint. Expected: either the capability (needs verifier/authority change and oracle adjudication) or a documented single derivation. Actual: two derivations that agree only because enumeration filters by the verifier. Suspected latent mismatch, not a confirmed bug.
title: OCM: admit or document Go t.Run case anchors on the parent func header line
